items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: when he left my band, he got a gig with Earl Hines as a second bone man

ctx.x: He went and bought a horn after a while. He went and bought his own.

And then, when he left my band, he got a gig with Earl Hines as a second bone man; they never did go for all that guitar, you know; Kirk did, but Hines or Basie never did go for all that guitar, and that's what he was playing.
